body.p:
The review task owners and reviewers can communicate directly in the browser interface:
Open the particular review task in the Content Fusion browser interface.
Select Task Activity from the left stripe.
Step Result: If you have a file from a review task open in the visual editor, the Task Activity pane opens to the left of the editor pane. If you have the review task open on any other page, the Task Activity page opens, showing all activity related to the task.
Click the Add Message button at the top-right corner of the Task Activity page (or if you are in the visual editor, click the ellipsis/3-vertical-dots in the top-right corner of the Task Activity pane and then select Add Message).
Enter your message in the resulting text field and click Add.
Result: Anyone who has access to the task can see the message on the Task Activity page or in the side view..
